source.title: Craftsman's Writ: Catseye Draught
source.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Catseye Draught, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
source.objective: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
